description:
Perform a One-Sample Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test to determine if the median 'Exam' score significantly differs from a test value of 50. 

The dataset '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/ExamAnxiety.csv' is already loaded. 

1. Go to T-Tests > One Sample T-Test.
2. Select 'Exam' as the variable.
3. Set the Test value to 50.
4. Under 'Tests', UNCHECK 'Student' and CHECK 'Wilcoxon signed-rank'.
5. Under 'Additional Statistics' (or Location Parameter section), enable the 'Location parameter' (Hodges-Lehmann estimate) and its 'Confidence interval'.
6. Enable 'Descriptive statistics'.

Save the analysis as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/Exam_Wilcoxon_Test.jasp'.

Create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/median_analysis_report.txt' containing:
- The Test Statistic (W)
- The p-value
- The Hodges-Lehmann estimate value
